module_role: Embedded DisplayPort Source or panel-Sink controller: drives/receives the Main Link (1/2/4 differential lanes, 8b/10b video micro-packets), runs the AUX channel (DPCD + eDP-specific block / link training / I2C-over-AUX EDID / backlight-over-AUX / PSR control), and handles HPD, Fast Link Training, Panel Self Refresh (RFB), and ASSR.
topology_description: Point-to-point Source -> single embedded panel Sink over the Main Link (1/2/4 lanes) plus a bidirectional AUX channel and an HPD sideband, on a short internal flex. No external connector and no MST tree.

integration_overview.clocking: embedded clock recovered by the panel Sink (no clock lane)
integration_overview.host_side_register_spec: DPCD over AUX (Receiver Capability / Link Configuration / Link Status + eDP-specific block at 00700h); panel EDID via I2C-over-AUX.
integration_overview.link_training: Fast Link Training + full Clock Recovery + Channel Equalization

interface_categories: Main Link — 1/2/4 differential lanes carrying the video micro-packet stream (8b/10b).
AUX channel — bidirectional half-duplex Manchester-II management channel (DPCD + eDP block / training / EDID / backlight / PSR).
HPD — Hot Plug Detect sideband (presence + IRQ_HPD).
DPCD — register space (incl. eDP-specific block) for capability / configuration / status / backlight / PSR.
Backlight — backlight control over AUX (and optional PWM pin).
Stream interface — pixel/audio source into Transfer Units + MSA.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single Source -> single embedded panel Sink over 1/2/4 Main Link lanes.
Source with Panel Self Refresh (RFB) for static-screen power saving.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: Main Link idle = blanking/idle symbols, no active video until trained; quiescent during PSR self-refresh; AUX bus released; HPD asserted while the panel is present. eDP is single-Sink (no MST).
soc_dependent_items: Source vs panel-Sink role and number of Main Link lanes (1/2/4).
PHY (SerDes / CDR, 8b/10b, swing/pre-emphasis, reduced-swing option) implementation.
DPCD implementation including the eDP-specific block, and the panel EDID I2C ROM.
Panel Self Refresh / Remote Frame Buffer (RFB) support and PSR2 selective update.
Backlight control method (AUX brightness vs PWM pin).
ASSR and Fast Link Training support.
Panel power / backlight sequencing and HPD handling.

low_power_modes.ACTIVE: Streaming video on the Main Link.
low_power_modes.PSR: Panel Self Refresh — panel refreshes from the RFB while the Main Link sleeps and the Source GPU may sleep.
low_power_modes.PSR2: Selective update — only changed regions re-transmitted on exit.
low_power_modes.SET_POWER_D3: Low power (SET_POWER DPCD = D3); Main Link idle; panel / backlight off.

device_classes_examples: Notebook / tablet / AIO internal panel (eDP Sink / TCON)
Embedded / industrial / automotive integrated display panel
eDP-to-LVDS or eDP-to-MIPI panel bridge IC
